prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A close-up, high-resolution image of a single almond in its shell being held in the jaws of a shiny, metallic nutcracker with wooden handles. The composition is tight and focused, with the almond centered in the frame, emphasizing the textured, ridged surface of the nutcracker and the rough, speckled shell of the almond. The background is a clean, soft white, creating a minimalist and modern aesthetic that draws all attention to the subject. The lighting is bright and even, with subtle reflections on the polished metal, highlighting its smooth, reflective quality. The overall style is crisp and clinical, with a shallow depth of field that blurs the background and sharpens the details of the nutcracker and almond, evoking a sense of anticipation and precision. The camera angle is slightly tilted, adding a dynamic feel to the otherwise static scene.
